description: Sends the confirmation and the reminder emails again to everyone who is already registered. That is what you want when a date or a time moved: "The webinar is now on Tuesday, send everyone the new confirmation." It needs the session, the webinar and a clear yes from you. Check first how many people would receive it and where the date really stands, and say that number out loud. These are real emails from your site to all of those registrants, so the step cannot be taken back. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: resend confirmation, date changed, send reminders again, new date, mail everyone again

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that all registrants may be mailed again.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_resend_webinar_mails
title: Send the confirmation and reminders again
